Create, view, and manage security investigation cases with timeline, IOCs, and evidence.

Examples:
  trace case create --title "Phishing campaign" --severity high
  trace case list
  trace case view <id>
  trace case note <id> "Found additional indicators"
  trace case ioc <id> --type ip --value 10.0.0.5
  trace case assign <id> --to analyst@example.com
  trace case close <id> --resolution "resolved"

Usage:
  trace case [flags]
  trace case [command]

Available Commands:
  assign      Assign a case to an analyst
  close       Close a case
  create      Create a new case
  evidence    Attach evidence to a case
  export      Export a case as JSON
  export-pdf  Export a case as PDF
  ioc         Add an IOC to a case
  list        List cases
  note        Add a note to a case
  view        View case details

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for case

Global Flags:
  -c, --config string   path to config file

Use "trace case [command] --help" for more information about a command.
